profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Senior Systems Analyst
profile.summary:
Senior-level Professional with a focus on Product Development. The combination of hands-on Research & Development experience, Manufacturing/Operations experience, and Program/Project Management experience provides for a unique set of competencies that contribute to the achievement of organizational goals and vision. Working for large, international, publicly traded companies as well as small entrepreneurial businesses also adds another dimension to my expertise. By using my abilities, motivation, and proficiencies, my goal is to provide a level of contribution above and beyond any company's expectation.

Specialties: Product Development, R&D, Project Management, Manufacturing Operations, and Deployment & Implementation.

Industries: Public Sector, Medical Device, and Biotechnology.

positions.title: Senior Software Analyst
positions.description:
• Modernized over 10 legacy applications using Blazor and .NET 8, enhancing usability and security.  
• Integrated backend services for JSON data processing and API interfacing, improving data handling efficiency.  
• Automated reporting with PowerBI and PowerShell, significantly boosting operational visibility.  
• Developed CI/CD pipelines in Azure, achieving a 50% reduction in deployment time.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Customer Relationship Management (CRM) · DevOps · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Pipelines · C# · Microsoft Azure · .Net · Git · .NET Framework

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Pembroke Pines, Florida, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Architected a pioneering flow cytometer, reducing testing time by 4 hours.  
• Developed microprocessor code in C, enhancing communication efficiency by 30%.  
• Co-designed software in Visual Basic and C# for seamless data processing and visualization.  
• Implemented a robust VoIP infrastructure, significantly improving communication across multiple locations.
